correctness.rationale: Every nonhub vertex of W_(r,t)=K1 join tK_r sees a rainbow neighborhood, so only hub parity matters. Optimal proper colorings are ordered t-tuples of r-subsets of p nonhub colors with each color in an odd number of cliques; all are used. For odd t, p=r is achieved by repeating the same r colors. For even t, odd nonzero column multiplicities are <=t−1, total rt, and p must be even, so p>=2ceil(rt/(2(t−1))). The construction distributing even increments among odd column multiplicities and placing contiguous color runs around t clique slots respects clique distinctness and attains the bound. Parity-character orthogonality yields the stated Krawtchouk signed sum and factors (p+1)(r!)^t; special cases odd t and t=2 checked. Independent XOR dynamic programming and an independently evaluated character sum match for 18 small parameter profiles and exclude all smaller palettes tested; not a universal proof by enumeration.
